android.widget.TextView.text: You don't have ideas because you don't read.

android.widget.TextView.text: You can't articulate ideas because you don't write.

android.widget.TextView.text: You can't leverage ideas because you don't build.
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: You feel bored, anxious, or overwhelmed because your mind wants ideas to flow but you won't let them.
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: I spent three years feeling exactly this way. Anxious. Bored. Overwhelmed. Thought I was just broken. Then I took a week off from everything. No reading. No scrolling. No podcasts. Just me and a notebook.
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: Day one was brutal. Day two was boring. Day three, I started writing down random questions I had about my own life. By day five, I had more ideas than I could fit in one notebook.
android.widget.TextView.heading: false

android.widget.TextView.text: Turns out, I didn't need more input.…
